topic: you're allowed to change your mind
lines: About the city you live in. The *dream* you used to have.
About who you thought you were *supposed* to be.
Of course some things don't fit *anymore.*
#The only mistake is staying somewhere you've outgrown...
just because you're scared of what people will *say.*
Staying the same to keep others *comfortable* is a slow way to disappear.
But they don't have to live your *life.*
#So if something in your heart has *shifted*...
Take the next step, even if it's a *small* one.
#You don't owe anyone the old version of *you.*
end: Send this to someone who's outgrowing their life.

post.caption: Changing your mind isn't failure. It's growth. 🌅
